anomalies.description: Large crowd engaged in violent unrest with a central fire, smoke (likely from tear gas or flares), and confrontational posture toward a line of riot police in the foreground; individuals are seen throwing objects and moving aggressively around the fire.

Large crowd engaged in violent unrest with fire, smoke, and confrontation against a line of riot police; objects appear to be thrown and fires burn in the middle of the street.; Continued violent unrest with heavy smoke, riot police advancing or holding position, and individuals on elevated ground appearing to throw objects toward police lines.; A large group of riot police in full gear confronts a group of individuals on a road at night; smoke and debris are present, and objects are being thrown (e.g., an object mid-air at f0), indicating active violent unrest and clashing.; Simultaneous with the fighting, the broader scene shows ongoing unrest: people moving erratically, some holding objects, fire visible in background, and barricades—indicating collective violent unrest beyond isolated scuffles.

In frame f12 (66.0s), a figure in dark clothing on an elevated median appears to discharge a firearm (muzzle flash or projectile trajectory not definitively visible, but posture and context suggest firing); this is supported by similar postures in adjacent frames f13–f15 where individuals aim objects toward police. However, no unambiguous muzzle flash or bullet trace is visible across frames, so confidence is moderate.

Behind barbed wire, multiple individuals engage in close physical altercations: pushing, grappling, and one person appears to be struck or falling (e.g., f8–f10 show dynamic motion and contact). This constitutes mutual physical combat among civilians.

Frame f12 shows a building with severe structural damage (collapsed roof, broken walls) and charred surfaces; frame f13 confirms same damage under daylight. While no blast is captured in-frame, the sudden appearance of this destruction between night (f11 at 73.5s) and next frame (f12 at 74.0s) strongly suggests a recent explosion occurred just before or during this interval. The damage is inconsistent with gradual decay or fire alone.
A group of individuals in dark uniforms engage in physical combat with one or more persons on a paved area near parked vehicles; visible striking, grappling, and use of batons/shields.
A person is forcibly restrained and struck by multiple uniformed individuals while on the ground at night; the victim appears helpless and is being beaten repeatedly.
